name: Toybox Fable
oneLine: Blocky same-height avatars with big drawn line-art faces in bright game-map towns, cut on every phrase (~1.2-1.5 s), camera mostly locked, bold rounded captions with one coloured keyword, music bed under a fast narrator.
bestFor: Kid-POV fables and twist mini-stories: a weird town rule told as a joke (37-39 s) or as a mystery with a loop/twist ending (136-158 s); comedy with creatures; mild eerie/night stories.
brightness: daytime mean luma 106-125 of 255 (measured 106, 108, 125); night/eerie films 85-99 with 11-25% dark frames; no vignette. Calibrated on our town square: luma 117 at Standard + 'High Contrast', exposure -1.0, sun 6.0, sky fill 0.3
saturation: HSV mean 0.38-0.46 daytime (measured 0.36-0.50); one saturated hero outfit + one keyword colour. Our scene calibrated: 0.43
avgShot: 1.2 s short / 1.3-1.5 s long (pooled 390 shots: mean 1.39, median 1.3, p10 0.7, p90 2.0; 39-50 cuts/min)
camera: 82-90% locked in short films (54-70% long); eye level ~75%, low ~15% for creatures, high ~10% for crowds; 26 mm standard (69.4 deg vFOV), 18 mm comic closes, 35 mm two-shots, 50 mm inserts; whip-in at frame 0 (lands f3, settled f8); long films add fly-throughs, crane reveals, swish pans (~21 fast moves/min); no shake
characters: Classic R6 blocks, everyone same height, rounded classic head, thick near-black hand-drawn faces (~14 expressions, swap on ~70% of face shots, instant), hero in bold 2-colour stripes (default Cast v2 hero kid in burnt-orange/cream stripes; never their heroes' combos), big crowds; creatures plush-round or shaggy-huge with glowing eyes, one humanising prop of our own; see CHARACTERS.md
textures: Smooth plastic bodies (roughness ~0.5) with printed 2D clothing (stripes, uniforms, plaid, knit); detailed game-map sets (cobbles, plaster, timber, slate, glass); no outlines, no grain, no grade
animation: Stock blocky idles/walks/emotes, rigid limbs, snappy; instant face swaps; prop physics gags (6-15 f); puff-ring and fire VFX; crowds staggered; camera moves fast-in ease-out; never a frozen frame
captions: Poppins Bold 88 px em (63 px caps; ASS Fontsize 156 +13 px y), white, 7 px #111111 stroke, soft 4 px shadow. Short: 2 same-size lines 88 px apart, block centred y 503 (26%): white lowercase line + UPPERCASE keyword line in the film's keyword colour, card ends on its keyword, 1-4 words (mean 2.7), hold ~0.7 s, hard swap. Long: 1 line centred y 1402 (73%), sentence case, 1-3 words (mean 1.8), keyword cards alone in colour (~1 in 3), hold ~0.5 s, optional 3-frame pop 85->100%. Spec: pack/captions_craftee-style.json
sound: Music bed ~7-10 dB under the voice in every film, dropped to silence once for the big beat; whoosh/pop/impact on 41-73% of cuts (73% in the creature short), low boom ~every 3 s in creature films incl. one on the opening whip; first-person narrator, target 4.5-5.0 words/s in short films (measured 4.7-4.9 short, 3.3-5.2 overall), no pauses between sentences
overrides: Camera: replaces 'steady opening then one smooth glide' with hard cuts throughout (median 1.2-1.3 s)
Camera: allows whip-in at frame 0 and fast fly-throughs/swish pans in long films (house bans whips/swings) - needs Jake's yes
Look: saturation 0.38-0.46 instead of 0.55-0.65; bright neutral daylight instead of deep saturated grade
Sound: music bed under narration (house: no looping music bed)
Frame 0: whip frame or loop frame, no title card (house: memorable picture with title)
Opening: 0.7-2.0 s locked shots, no punch-ins (house: 1.2-3 s, camera never still)
Evening rules: steady cameras overridden for T1/T5/T8; eased movement kept for camera, overridden for faces (instant swaps); staggered timing kept; believable faces replaced by cartoon line-art faces
Cast v2: kid scale 0.8 replaced by everyone at 1.0

techniques.name: T1 Whip-in opening (blurred frame 0)
techniques.timing: f0 mid-swing blur, lands f3, -2 deg overshoot f5, settled f8; whoosh + boom peak f4-f6
techniques.size: 25-35 deg swing; 2 deg overshoot (~48 px; measured 30-60)
techniques.recipe: whip_in(cam, f0): Bezier keys +30@f-3, 0@f3, -2@f5, 0@f8; shutter 1.5 on f0-f3 only

techniques.name: T2 Hard cut on the phrase
techniques.timing: on the first word's onset, +/-3 f
techniques.recipe: cut_plan(word_timings, fmt): short 0.6-2.1 s (target 1.2), long 0.6-2.3 s (target 1.4); no dissolves

techniques.name: T3 Locked-off shot
techniques.recipe: lock(cam, f0, f1)

techniques.name: T4 Slow drift
techniques.recipe: drift(cam, f0, f1, px_per_s=200, direction='truck_left'); 2D: post drift2d. Push variant +8% is an estimate

techniques.name: T5 Fly-through with foreground wipe
techniques.recipe: fly_through(cam, points, f0, 24, occluder=pole) -> cut_window; pass within 1.7 BU (0.5 m)

techniques.name: T6 Crane-out reveal with roll
techniques.size: 1.2 H -> 18 H (108 BU, ~30 m) up; 40 deg roll to level
techniques.recipe: crane_out(cam, kid, f0)

techniques.name: T7 Snap pull-out
techniques.trigger: revealing how big a gag is
techniques.recipe: snap_pull(cam, f0, subject=kid) (dolly x2.5) or mode='zoom' (65 -> 26 mm)

techniques.name: T8 Swish pan within shot
techniques.trigger: following a runner/boat to a new composition
techniques.recipe: swish(cam, f0): shutter 0.5 on those frames only

techniques.name: T9 Follow-the-prop
techniques.size: camera ~1 BU (0.3 m) from prop, roll up to 15 deg
techniques.recipe: animate prop, then follow_prop(cam, prop, f0, f1)

techniques.name: T10 Tracking truck with runner
techniques.size: runner speed, side 2.4 H (14.4 BU, ~4 m), chest height 0.7 H
techniques.recipe: animate runner, then track_runner(cam, runner_root, f0, f1); pillar wipe

techniques.name: T11 Face-swap punch
techniques.recipe: face_set(head_mat, face_001.png); face_swaps(head_mat, [(frame, 'shocked'), ...]) (CONSTANT)

techniques.name: T12 Prop physics gag
techniques.recipe: hat_pop(hat, f0)

techniques.name: T13 Puff-ring / fire VFX
techniques.timing: rings 15 f, 3 f apart; fire 9 f to full
techniques.size: rings 0.3 -> 0.9 H across; fire to 1.2 H
techniques.recipe: puff_rings(mouth_loc, f0); fire particles #FF8A2A emission 5 + bloom(scene)

techniques.name: T14 Locked-off time-skip montage
techniques.recipe: time_skip(cam, f0) + light_rig('day'/'dusk'/'evening'/'night') per beat; crowd thins

techniques.name: T15 Light pulse
techniques.recipe: light_pulse(f, loc) (2000 W x 3.3^2); 2D: post pulse --frames f

techniques.name: T16 Black beat
techniques.recipe: light_rig('black') + practical(loc, 30); music drop-out

techniques.name: T17 Dutch tilt
techniques.frequency: 0 short; ~18% of shots in one long film
techniques.recipe: dutch(cam, f0, f1, 15); never on the triumph shot

techniques.name: T18 Prop insert (ECU)
techniques.recipe: prop_insert(cam, prop, f0, f1): 50 mm, distance from prop size; prop 1.3x, flat light

techniques.name: T19 Zoom-through loop ending
techniques.trigger: final reveal linking to the opening
techniques.recipe: frame 0 on an in-world screen; zoom_through(cam, screen, f_end); post loopcheck

techniques.name: T20 Mirror + white flash (cinematic only)
techniques.recipe: post flash --frames f

techniques.name: T21 Swing-and-settle (cinematic only)
techniques.recipe: swing_settle(cam, f0)

techniques.name: T22 Letterbox 3:4 (cinematic only)
techniques.recipe: post letterbox

techniques.name: T23 Caption scale pop (long, optional)
techniques.recipe: post captions --fmt long (every 3rd card)

techniques.name: T24 Sound-synced cuts
techniques.timing: transient within +/-4 f of the cut
techniques.recipe: post sfx --plan plan.json (shot 1 + every 2nd cut, or --shots)

techniques.name: T25 Music drop-out
techniques.recipe: post dropout music.wav out.wav --ranges a-b (music stem)

techniques.name: T26 Walk-to-camera reframe
techniques.size: full body 60% of frame height -> head 40% of frame width (7.2 -> 4.2 BU at 26 mm)
techniques.recipe: locked camera; walk_to_camera(person, cam, f0)

techniques.name: NOT USED: camera shake, zoom punches, speed ramps, slow-mo, freeze/stutter frames, impact/invert flashes, vignette, grain, CA, stickers/emoji
techniques.recipe: do not add; if Jake insists: impact_shake(cam, f) / post shake (8 px, 12 Hz, 8 f)

units: Our scenes: 1 m = 3.3 Blender units; Cast v2 people ~6 units tall (everyone at s=1.0 in this style); pack converts light watts (x3.3^2) and DOF f-stops (/3.3)

calibrated.scene: /tmp/claude-0/kits/look_test.py town square (Cast v2 hero, sister, guard; a1_* town models), Cycles
